source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Ensure that the details of the accident are recorded immediately after it occurs to prevent details from being forgotten or misremembered. Include the following components:

- Time and date of the incident
- Location of the incident (specific area within the workplace)
- Description of what happened (how the accident occurred, what led to the accident, and the sequence of events)
- The names and roles of all individuals involved (victim(s), witnesses, etc.)
- A detailed description of visible injuries or property damage
- Photos of the scene, if possible and safe to take

3. Interview witnesses.
Conduct interviews as soon as possible after the accident to collect accurate accounts. Document the following:

- Names of the witnesses
- Exact statements (use quotation marks) or a summary of what the witness saw or experienced
- The position of each witness relative to the incident
- Any relevant observations or comments made by the witness

4. Collect initial medical reports.
